info.title: Panel-owned Cursor SDK
info.description: HL-238@3. Companion to youtrack-panel.openapi.json. Consultation with selected issue and project Knowledge Base. Owner explicitly authorized this context flow to Cursor. No bot integration. One active run, at most 16 session-visible records, ten minute deadline. Web sessions and history are memory-only. Runs and deduplication belong to the verified YouTrack user ID, survive logout/session expiry and remain accessible after owner re-login for eight hours after terminal. Logout revokes web access only, not the active run's bounded YouTrack capability. Service restart cancels runs and loses history. This is not durable managed-task admission. All POSTs require exact Origin, Host, CSRF and application/json; all endpoints reject query parameters and unknown request fields. No POST auto-retry; explicit retry must retain the entire original command with its ID while the original record exists for the same principal.

get.summary: Read only this verified user's runs; reconnect/readback

post.summary: Start a task-bound SDK consultation or read back an identical command

200.description: Volatile command receipt or existing run; never a durable admission ACK

post.summary: Request cancellation of the exact user-owned run; terminal readback confirms stop

200.description: cancel_requested or existing terminal state; poll for completion

Error.description: 400 invalid request; 401 missing/expired session; 403 origin/CSRF denied; 404 foreign/absent run; 409 conflicting command/context; 429 occupied worker/history capacity; 503 Cursor not configured

issue_id.description: Exact readable ID in the configured YouTrack project

parent_id.description: Empty for a new dialog; otherwise exact own finished run for the same issue. At most last 3 turns, each answer <=8192 UTF-8 bytes.

expected_updated.description: Exact YouTrack issue updated timestamp read before submission; not Task Revision/admission.

result.description: Nonempty only after SDK terminal finished + successful worker exit; UTF-8 byte limit

error.description: Safe fixed code; no credentials, raw exceptions or tool arguments
